commit.subject: LU-10026 tests: memory check depends on RAM
commit.message:
LU-10026 tests: memory check depends on RAM

Each open file consumes about 4.7KB of RAM, 300000
files consume about 1.3GB. At systems with 2.6GB RAM
it might cause an OOM with SLOW=yes option.
1. Consume 40% of RAM to check that page pools would be
shrinked.
2. Change createmany with memhog.
3. Export MEMHOG in init_test_env.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
Fixes: 14fc034e983e ("LU-18086 obdclass: page_pools shrinker fix")
DDN-bug-id: EX-10278
Signed-off-by: Sergey Cheremencev <scherementsev@ddn.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: I58ae0a201456ed084db5c528007fe8d7a3782315
